content:
[Intro]
[A5]

[Verse 1]
[Dm/A]The Rain in endless
fall, pouring
down on the streets;
Our
[A5]tears trailing
down all at once, Like they
all fell from the
same face.
Oh, [A5]

[Verse 2]
God... Dark
days have come, [C5]
how could this [E5]
happen here? [A5]
Of all the [C5]
darkness [E5]overcome,
how could hatred
persevere? [A5]
And what was
so [C5]unbearable
you felt the [E5]
need to take a [A5]life?
All of us have [C5]felt
this, how could [E5]we
keep our com-
posure now?

[Breakdown]
[A5]Oh, God!
Why is she gone?
All we can do is cry...
DES-
TROYER!
Where was your heart?!
Why did she have to die?!

[Verse 3]
[Fmaj7]In the skies, she waits
[Dsus2]for us, with that
[A5]smile still on her face.
[C5]
[Fmaj7]I know you miss the ones
[Dsus2]you loved, but
[A5]we all know you're in
[C5]a better place!
[Fmaj7]Can you
[Dsus2]hear us now? (Can you
[A5]hear us now?!) We're
[C5]speaking out to you!
[Fmaj7]You're not forgotten and we'll
[Dsus2]see you again... soon!

[Outro]
[A5]
But as for
him...
Some of us have wished her
fate upon you. I've heard them
say they wish you'd die.
But we won't let you take the
easy way out. You will reg-
ret this all your life...
You will be
suffering all your life.
Fuck
title: Destroyer
tuning: A E A D G B E
